summary: Make authorization consumption atomic across processes and serialize authorized KVM execution by target, independent of authorization-store path, and normalize patch-ledger dates.
reason: Review verification found that process-local mutexes did not protect shared authorization files or physical action sequences across CLI processes, and patch timestamps did not match the date-only ledger convention.
validated_outcome: Atomic token consumption and execution serialization are protected by platform file locks; focused and full module validation passed.
